title: Correlation flow governs learning at criticality
abstract: arXiv:2608.08350v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The initialization of deep neural networks determines whether information and gradients can propagate across depth, yet a unified theory connecting these properties to learning dynamics remains elusive. Combining mean-field theory and random matrix theory, we establish a direct link between correlation propagation and the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) that governs learning in the sequential limit of infinitely wide, infinitely deep networks. Correlation propagation to infinite depth is possible only at a single, critical point in the weight-bias variance plane. At this point, we leverage the algebraic decay of the end-to-end Jacobian with depth to prove that the NTK becomes exactly proportional to the output correlation at infinite depth, tying together information propagation and learning dynamics. translated_title: 关联流在临界点支配学习
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络的初始化决定了信息和梯度能否沿深度方向传播，然而将这些性质与学习动力学联系起来的统一理论仍然缺失。本文结合平均场理论和随机矩阵理论，在无限宽、无限深网络的序贯极限下，建立了关联传播与控制学习的神经正切核（NTK）之间的直接联系。关联传播到无限深度只有在权重-偏置方差平面上的单一临界点才可能实现。在该临界点上，我们利用端到端雅可比矩阵随深度的代数衰减，证明了在无限深度下NTK严格正比于输出关联，从而将信息传播与学习动力学联系在一起。我们进一步证明，正交初始化能够抑制高斯初始化下存在的主要有限尺寸修正，澄清了……
tldr: 该论文结合平均场理论与随机矩阵理论，证明了深度神经网络仅在权重-偏置方差平面上的临界点处可实现无限深度关联传播，且此时无限深度下的神经正切核（NTK）严格正比于输出关联，从而建立了信息传播与学习动力学的统一联系。
en_tdlr: Combining mean-field theory and random matrix theory, this paper proves that correlation propagation to infinite depth is possible only at a single critical point, where the NTK becomes exactly proportional to the output correlation, unifying information propagation and learning dynamics in infinitely wide, deep networks.
